candidates.tagline: Trinity Univ. spent a year redesigning their logo. Alumni revolted in 5 days.
candidates.story: Trinity University unveiled a new sunburst logo on July 30, 2026, replacing the iconic 166-foot Murchison Tower — then paused the entire rollout within five days after alumni flooded social media saying it looked like every hotel and bank logo ever made.
candidates.why_funny: After consulting over 300 people for nearly a year, they produced something so generic that the university itself had to hit pause before anyone even ordered new stationery.
candidates.alt: Murchison Tower at Trinity University in San Antonio — a tall Gothic stone bell tower on the campus skyline.

candidates.tagline: Ferrari's 'ugly' EV that nobody wanted just sold for $40 million.
candidates.story: Ferrari unveiled its first electric car, the Luce, designed by Jony Ive — critics called it 'an aesthetic and technological insult to anyone who loves Ferrari' and compared it to a Nissan Leaf, sending stock down 8%; then Chassis 0 sold at Sotheby's for $40M, sixty times its retail price.
candidates.why_funny: The car so many people said looked wrong for Ferrari turned out to be so collectible as history's first Ferrari EV that it fetched the highest price ever paid at auction for a new vehicle.
candidates.alt: The all-white Ferrari Luce Chassis 0 on display at RM Sotheby's auction house in Monterey, California.
